```{r setup, include=FALSE}
## Global options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = F, warning = F, message = F)

library(INLA)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(nowcaster)
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)
library(scoringutils)
library(purrr)

source("fit_predict_models.R")
```


## Dados
```{r}
dados <- readRDS("Dados\\den_chik_2017_2019_RJ.RData")
dados <- dados %>% janitor::clean_names()

dados %>% 
  filter(dt_sin_pri > ymd("2017-01-01")) %>% 
  group_by(year(dt_sin_pri), epiweek(dt_sin_pri), arbo) %>% 
  summarise(y = n(), date = min(dt_sin_pri)) %>%  
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = date, y = y, colour = arbo) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r, fig.width=10}
## Guardando os dados reais
data_real <- dados |>
  filter(dt_sin_pri > ymd("2017-01-01")) |>
  select(dt_digita, dt_sin_pri, arbo) |>
  tidyr::drop_na(dt_digita) |>
  mutate(delay = as.numeric(floor(difftime(dt_digita, dt_sin_pri, units = "weeks")))) |>
  group_by(dt_sin_pri, delay, arbo)|>
  summarise(y = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(epiweek = epiweek(dt_sin_pri), year = year(dt_sin_pri)) %>% 
  group_by(year, epiweek, arbo) |>
  summarise(y = sum(y), date = min(dt_sin_pri)) 


data <- dados |>
  filter(dt_sin_pri > ymd("2017-01-01")) |>
  select(dt_digita, dt_sin_pri, arbo) |>
  tidyr::drop_na(dt_digita) |>
  mutate(delay = as.numeric(floor(difftime(dt_digita, dt_sin_pri, units = "weeks")))) |>
  group_by(dt_sin_pri, delay, arbo)|>
  summarise(y = n()) |>
  filter(delay <= 15) 
```


```{r}
data |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(epiweek = epiweek(dt_sin_pri), year = year(dt_sin_pri)) |>
  group_by(epiweek, year, delay, arbo) |>
  summarise(y = sum(y)) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = delay, values_from = y) |>
  mutate_if(~is.numeric(.), ~coalesce(.,0)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = 4:19, names_to = "delay", values_to = "y") |>
  mutate(delay = as.numeric(delay)) |>
  arrange(year, epiweek, delay) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = arbo, values_from = y) -> data 


data %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(year < 2019 | epiweek <= 20) %>% 
  mutate(chik_obs = ifelse(epiweek + delay > 20 & year == 2019, NA, Chik),
         den_obs = ifelse(epiweek + delay > 20 & year == 2019, NA, Den)) -> data_model
```



```{r}
maxtime <- ymd("2017-08-01") + weeks(1:125)


purrr::map(maxtime, ~(
  data %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(year < year(.x) | epiweek <= epiweek(.x)) %>% 
  filter(year <= year(.x)) %>% 
  mutate(chik_obs = ifelse(epiweek + delay > epiweek(.x) & year == year(.x) , NA, Chik),
         den_obs = ifelse(epiweek + delay > epiweek(.x) & year ==year(.x) , NA, Den))
)) -> data_model_list


purrr::map(maxtime, ~(
  data_real %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(year < year(.x) | epiweek <= epiweek(.x)) %>% 
  filter(year <= year(.x)) %>% 
  mutate(time = rep(1:(nrow(.)/2), each = 2)) %>%  # PODE DAR ERRO
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "arbo", values_from = "y") %>% 
  rename(y1 = Chik, y2 = Den)
)) -> data_real_list

```


```{r}
# escrever como função o ajuste do univariado e do bivariado talvez de forma que ja cuspa as métricas agregadas para os intervalos
# ou uma função pra ajustar os modelos e outra pra avaliar, sei lá 

data_model_compare <- data_model_list[seq(1,125, by = 10)]
data_real_compare <- data_real_list[seq(1,125, by = 10)]

```

```{r}
load("bivariado.RData")
load("chik_univariado.RData")
load("dengue_univariado.RData")

bvdengue <- purrr::map2(bivar_fits, data_real_compare, calculate_score, disease = "dengue", bivar = T)
bvchik <- purrr::map2(bivar_fits, data_real_compare, calculate_score, disease = "chik", bivar = T)
unichik <- purrr::map2(uni_chik_fits, data_real_compare, calculate_score, disease = "chik", bivar = F)
unidengue <- purrr::map2(uni_dengue_fits, data_real_compare, calculate_score, disease = "dengue", bivar = F)
```

## Avaliação dos modelos

```{r}
bvdengue |> 
  map(~{. |> 
          select(score_95:range_50) |> 
          summarise_all(list(mean = mean,
                             max = max,
                             last = last))
          }) |> 
  bind_rows() -> metricas_bivar_dengue

bvchik |> 
  map(~{. |> 
          select(score_95:range_50) |> 
          summarise_all(list(mean = mean,
                             max = max,
                             last = last))
          }) |> 
  bind_rows() -> metricas_bivar_chik

unichik |> 
  map(~{. |> 
          select(score_95:range_50) |> 
          summarise_all(list(mean = mean,
                             max = max,
                             last = last))
          }) |> 
  bind_rows() -> metricas_uni_chik

unidengue |> 
  map(~{. |> 
          select(score_95:range_50) |> 
          summarise_all(list(mean = mean,
                             max = max,
                             last = last))
          }) |> 
  bind_rows() -> metricas_uni_dengue

```


```{r}
metricas_bivar_chik |> 
  bind_rows(metricas_uni_chik) |> 
  mutate(modelo = rep(c("bivariado", "univariado"), each = 13)) -> metricas_chik

metricas_bivar_dengue |> 
  bind_rows(metricas_uni_dengue) |> 
  mutate(modelo = rep(c("bivariado", "univariado"), each = 13)) -> metricas_dengue

```

### Métricas para o último intervalo

#### Chikungunya 

```{r}
metricas_chik |> 
  mutate(run = rep(1:13, 2)) |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = run, y = score_95_last, col = modelo) +
  geom_line(size = .8) +
  labs(title = "Interval score para o último intervalo de 95% de credibilidade") +
  theme_light() #-> gg_int_90

metricas_chik |> 
  mutate(run = rep(1:13, 2)) |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = run, y = range_95_last, col = modelo) +
  geom_line(size = .8) +
  labs(title = "Tamanho do último intervalo de 95% de credibilidade") +
  theme_light()

 #
```

## Análise mais detalhada

### Primeiro pico 

 Dados até `r max(data_real_compare[[5]]$date)`

#### Chikungunya

```{r}
chik_details_bv <- bvchik[[5]] |> 
  select(-c(Median_y2:LSb_y2)) |> 
  rename(Media = Median_y1) |> 
  mutate(modelo = "bivariado")

chik_details_uni <- unichik[[5]] |>
  mutate(modelo = "univariado")

chik_details <- chik_details_bv |> 
  bind_rows(chik_details_uni)

chik_details |> 
ggplot() +
  aes(x = time, y = score_95, colour = modelo) +
  geom_line(size = .8) +
  labs(y = "Score para o intervalo de 95% de credibilidade",
       colour = "Modelo") +
  theme_light()


chik_details |> 
ggplot() +
  aes(x = time, y = range_95, colour = modelo) +
  geom_line(size = .8) +
  labs(y = "Score para o intervalo de 95% de credibilidade",
       colour = "Modelo") +
  theme_light()
```
